title: Pushout of an extension gives the contracted-product torsor
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $G,G'$ abelian sheaves on $X_{\mathrm{Zar}}$ [def-sc-zariski-site, def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], and $\varphi:G\to G'$ a morphism. Let $0\to G\xrightarrow{j}E\xrightarrow{p}\mathbf Z_X\to0$ be a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves, where $\mathbf Z_X$ is the constant integer sheaf. Its *fibre over $1$* is $T=E\times_{\mathbf Z_X,1}*$, the sheaf of lifts of the global section $1$, with $G$ acting by translation through $j$. Define the *pushout extension* $E_{\varphi}=(E\oplus G')/\{(j(g),-\varphi(g)):g\in G\}$, with its induced injection of $G'$ and projection to $\mathbf Z_X$. Define the *contracted product* $T\wedge^G G'$ as the sheafification of $(T\times G')/G$ for $g\cdot(t,g')=(g\cdot t,\varphi(g)^{-1}g')$. Then $0\to G'\to E_{\varphi}\to\mathbf Z_X\to0$ is short exact and its fibre over $1$ is canonically the $G'$-torsor $T\wedge^G G'$ [def-sc-gm-torsor].
